review.algorithm_assessment: Nonintersecting rectangular closed barriers partition cells by the set of rectangles containing them: same membership set iff same reachable region. Maintain128-bit rectangle fingerprints with XOR rectangle-add/remove and point queries via a2D Fenwick difference grid. Deterministic BLAKE2b of full rectangle coordinates allows exact undo of the same barrier. This is a fingerprint algorithm: distinct containment sets can theoretically collide; it is not a proof of collision-free correctness. Public verification compares exact rectangle sets and literal blocked-edge BFS, and fixed verifier must pass unchanged. No reference answers or coordinate-specific rules. Memory dense pointers plus touched128-bit entries remain bounded by2501^2 cells.
